home.title: Afterlife
home.tagline: Software that outlives its source code.
home.subline: No source code. No developer. Just the .exe.

urdu.title: Rules in Urdu
urdu.missing: {count, plural, one {# rule has} other {# rules have}} no Urdu yet.
urdu.how: The worker asks the language model for each translation and keeps it only if it uses the shop words (bill: بل, stock: اسٹاک, GST: جی ایس ٹی, udhaar: ادھار). A rule translated before comes from the cache. The result is stored as a new Soul version.
urdu.running: The worker is translating the rules…
urdu.done: Translated. The Soul now shows the rules in Urdu.

check.title: Check a rule
check.body: Each candidate is run on every observation. It is kept only if it gives the value the old app wrote every time, and the simplest of those wins. The Archaeologist checks the model’s candidates the same way.
check.unconfigured: The API is not configured, so rules cannot be checked.
check.noValues: {count, plural, =0 {No observations yet: let the Possessor explore the app, or record a séance.} one {# observation, but the old app wrote no numbers in it.} other {# observations, but the old app wrote no numbers in them.}}
check.targetOption: {target}: {effects, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} in {observations, plural, one {# observation} other {# observations}}
check.candidates: Candidate rules, one per line (up to 10)
check.run: {count, plural, one {Check against # observation} other {Check against # observations}}
check.selectedDetail: Explains {effects, plural, one {the # value} other {all # values}} in {observations, plural, one {# observation} other {# observations}}. {nodes, plural, one {# node} other {# nodes}}. Confidence {confidence}%, threshold coverage {coverage}%.
check.none: {count, plural, one {No candidate explains the # value.} other {No candidate explains all # values.}}
check.noEffects: The old app never wrote this value.
check.explains: Explains {explained} of {total, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} · {nodes, plural, one {# node} other {# nodes}}
check.miss: The old app wrote {expected}; this gives {got}
check.missError: The old app wrote {expected}; this gives no value ({error})
check.probes: Probes to ask the Possessor for

vessel.title: Run an action in the Vessel
vessel.body: The reborn app is this runtime running the Soul. Type what the owner would, and it works out the rest from the rules, on the old app’s own data files, then shows what it changed in the same diff format as the old app’s. A copy in this page: start again any time.
vessel.loading: Reading the old app’s data files…
vessel.bundleFailed: The old app’s data files could not be loaded ({status}).
vessel.noActions: This Soul has no actions yet, so there is nothing to run.
vessel.noData: The data for an uploaded app comes with the Undertaker: it is not here yet.
vessel.cannotRun: The Vessel cannot run this action: {message}

status.invalid: Answer refused: did not fit its schema
